heading: THE FIELD TEST №18
sub: groundstation · 3 prompts re-run · 1 live artifact · 3 fixed, 0 partly, 0 the same · October 26, 2026 · Development Seed labs
lede: The 3 cards that stops 31 to 33 were charted to fix, asked again in the same words on main at 0.55.0 (PRs 97 to 99, landed the same day). Planetary Computer Sentinel-2 statistics now come back scaled by the collection convention and say so, the Casco Bay recommendation ends with the step that dropped the newest scene, and the Chelan brief runs on one pick with its NDVI baseline ranked over the place. Each learning opens with its verdict, grounded only in the new output: 3 fixed, 0 partly, 0 the same.

cases.answer: Both Planetary Computer Sentinel-2 scenes over the Rolling Fork box now come back scaled, and the result says where the factors came from. The data is Sentinel-2 L2A from Microsoft Planetary Computer, tile 15SXS (100.0% of the box; the 15SYS tile covers only 41.1%). The 2023-08-18 scene (processing baseline 05.09) got scale 0.0001 and offset -0.1; the 2021-10-12 scene (baseline 03.00) got scale 0.0001 and offset 0; both say scaling_applied: true and source "collection convention: the item carries no raster:bands". The statistics are keyed by the expression, not B04_b1. The 2023 NDVI mean is 0.5358 (median 0.5799) and the 2021 mean is -0.0169, but the 2021 scene is 65.04% cloud (the scene-wide figure), so -0.0169 is not a usable vegetation figure and this card uses it only to test the scaling, not as a before picture. The 2023 min of -64.0 and max of 4.07 are outside the -1 to 1 range NDVI can take when both bands are positive, so some scaled pixels went below 0 after the -0.1 offset; the 2nd and 98th percentiles (0.1026, 0.9498) are the safer range. This is index statistics over a 14 by 11 km box, not damage evidence.
cases.learning: Fixed. Stop 31's commit message (PR 97) said of Planetary Computer Sentinel-2: "means were raw DN and an NDVI was biased with no warning". Field tests 15 and 16 contain no compute_statistics call on Planetary Computer sentinel-2-l2a, so there is no earlier transcript of the silent raw result to quote; that commit message is the record. Now both scenes return scaling_applied: true and a band_scaling entry with scale 0.0001, source "collection convention: the item carries no raster:bands", offset -0.1 on the baseline 05.09 scene and 0 on the baseline 03.00 scene, and the key is the expression "(B08-B04)/(B08+B04)". Two differences from the expected shape: band_scaling is one entry listing 12 bands (B01 to B09, B11, B12 and B8A, B04 and B08 among them) rather than separate B04 and B08 entries, and I used tile 15SXS because it covers the whole box, not stop 31's 15SXT, so the means differ from its 0.2433 and 0.2042 and I did not reproduce those. Not checked: the apply_scaling=False path, a scene between baselines 03.xx and 04.00, and whether 0.5358 holds against an independent source.
cases.shows: stop 31 collection-convention scaling on Planetary Computer sentinel-2-l2a · scaling_applied true on both scenes · offset -0.1 at baseline 05.09, 0 at baseline 03.00 · stats keyed by the expression · band_scaling source named

cases.answer: The harbor-approach pick for Portland, Maine is the 2026-10-05 scene and the reason now says why the newest day, 2026-10-21, was passed over. The bare name "Portland" is ambiguous (4 candidates, states spelled out: Oregon twice, Maine twice), so I used the Casco Bay box the earlier card used. Over the window the newest day is 2026-10-21 (23.01% cloud at 100.0% coverage, and 2.63% cloud at 66.6%). The pick, LC09_L2SP_012030_20261005_02_T1 (15.28% cloud, 100.0% coverage), ends its reason with "the newest, 2026-10-21, lost on cloud: 23.0% against the pick's 15.3%, outside the 5-point tie". Asked with limit=3 the same search returns 3 scenes (two on 10-21, one on 10-14), picks the 10-21 scene, and adds no clause. Newest is not the same as best here: 7.7 points of cloud separate them.
cases.learning: Fixed. Field test 16 quoted the reason "15.3% cloud but covers 100.0% of the area; the clearest scene (0.3% cloud) covers 84.2%" and gave no word on why the 2026-10-21 scene, the newest, was not chosen. Now the reason ends with "the newest, 2026-10-21, lost on cloud: 23.0% against the pick's 15.3%, outside the 5-point tie". Read against the scene list (my reading; the output names only the cloud step), the figures fit it: of the 8 scenes, the 10-13 pair is at 100% cloud and the 10-14 scene at 53.29% is over the 30% ceiling; the coverage band (within 5 points of 100.0) keeps the two 012030 scenes, 10-21 at 23.01% and 10-05 at 15.28%; the gap is 7.73 points, outside the 5-point tie, so cloud is the step that dropped the newest. The 2.63% scene on 10-21 covers only 66.6%, so it would have fallen at the coverage step, and the clause correctly quotes the 100%-coverage 10-21 scene. With limit=3 the pick is the newest day (2026-10-21), and the clause is correctly absent. Not checked: the ceiling-step and coverage-step wordings, which no live data here reaches, and a render of the pick.
cases.shows: stop 32 reason names the step that dropped the newest scene · cloud step quoted as 23.0% against 15.3% outside the 5-point tie · clause absent when the pick is the newest day (limit=3) · geocode ambiguity still lists 4 Portlands with states

cases.answer: The brief now names one scene, S2C_10UFU_20261023_0_L2A, in its caption, map layer, preview URL and stac-map link, and the NDVI baseline is a second 10UFU scene that covers the same 47.6% of the county. The baseline S2C_10UFU_20261003_0_L2A is from 2026-10-03, 0.004% cloud, also 47.6%, so the 2 coverages do not differ and caveats is empty, as it should be. cases.learning: Fixed. Stop 33's status line in the course file said the pick, caption, map layer, preview and stac-map link come from one key, that the baseline is searched and ranked over the place by the same key on the same tile within 44 days ending a day before the window, and that the change block carries cloud and coverage on both scenes with a caveat past a 20 point gap. The new output shows S2C_10UFU_20261023_0_L2A in the caption, the map layer, the preview URL and the stac-map link, and nothing else. The change block holds cloud (8.8687 and 0.004074) and covers_aoi_pct (47.6 and 47.6) for both, the baseline is on tile 10UFU dated 2026-10-03 (inside 2026-09-04 to 2026-10-18), and no caveat appears because the gap is 0 points. Before the fix the baseline claimed 94.9% (a share of the tile); now it is 47.6% over the place. The run picked 2026-10-03, not the S2B_10UFU_20261018 baseline (10.2% cloud) of the pre-fix run; the output shows only the pick, so why 10-18 lost is not shown here. The caveat branch itself was not exercised, since the 2 coverages matched.
